scope: ADR-0085 P4-B NORMAL three-round compound-research journey (no fault matrix). One compound ResearchTask is driven through the real Product API, the authenticated Runtime Adapter judgment route, the real DSH child/tool invocation and the committed Backend deterministic seams: create compound task -> conversation continuation grant -> bounded strategy-draft judgment -> exact plan-bound strategy approval -> task-create approval -> deterministic create -> data-ready -> execute approval -> deterministic execute -> backtest-completed -> backtest-analysis judgment -> iteration_comparison -> three rounds -> final-selection judgment -> BYQ deterministic best-result selection and ResearchTask completed -> one simulated paper account created through the real Product API. Every judgment request runs through the ADR-0086 request-scoped provider gate (provider call / input / output / tool payload / deadline / attempt / concurrency) which records the DECLARED ceiling separately from the provider-reported ACTUAL usage. The model only ever submits a bounded research proposal. P4-B proves ONLY the normal research main chain; the paper-account approval binding is an OPEN BLOCKER (no closed plan/approval gate exists), so the P4-B verdict is format_valid=true, all_pass=false. P4-B never claims the P4 fault matrix, P4-C, an overall P4 all_pass or phase completion.
llm_evidence_note: A keyless deterministic journey-aware provider drives every judgment stage through the real DSH child/tool path. This is service-boundary/contract evidence, NOT real-LLM research-quality semantic evidence.

required_journey_steps.description: Exactly one compound ResearchTask exists and is running/completed.
A conversation continuation grant created exactly one execution plan.
The bounded strategy_draft judgment advanced the plan to waiting_for_strategy_approval.
The exact plan-bound strategy approval was approved.
The exact plan-bound backtest-task-create approval was approved.
The deterministic create action recorded a signal job.
A data-ready event advanced the plan with zero model calls.
The exact plan-bound backtest-execute approval was approved.
The deterministic execute action queued a backtest job.
A backtest-completed event advanced the plan to backtest_analysis.
Each of the three rounds ran a bounded backtest_analysis judgment.
The plan advanced iteration 1->2->3 through the exact create gate, never skipping.
The final-selection judgment converges the plan to the deterministic paper-account approval gate (waiting_for_paper_account_approval); completion happens only after the plan-bound account creation.

The simulated account is created exactly once through the exact plan-bound paper_account_create approval (ADR-0087) and the real Product API; an exact replay returns the same account, the deterministic action CAS completes the plan/task, and no order/position/fill is created.
ResearchTask and plan agree on completion.

required_gate_rows.description: Every judgment request declared a closed request-scoped budget from its OWN named BYQ-trusted stage profile (full provider call/input/declared output/tool payload/deadline/attempt/concurrency limits plus an evidence note); no global constant and no caller override.
Both root and child provider requests traversed the gate and were admitted within budget.
Each judgment request had its own budget/identity; counters are request-scoped, not a cross-process fixed max-2.

Every over-budget, over-limit, unprovable-usage or late request was refused BEFORE/INSTEAD OF forwarding (host negative controls); unknown stage/profile, missing fields and forged/raised caller budgets fail closed.

ADR-0086 §3: receipts record the DECLARED ceiling separately from provider-reported ACTUAL input/cache/output tokens and elapsed time, or a structured unknown; a proven over-ceiling or non-forwarded result is never PASS.

paper_account_decision: ADR-0087 (Accepted 2026-09-25): the simulated account enters the research loop ONLY through the BYQ deterministic plan/approval/action path. final_selection hands off to waiting_for_paper_account_approval; the exact plan-command-bound paper_account_create approval authorizes ready_to_create_paper_account; BYQ derives name/cash/resource/params_digest/idempotency_key; the trusted consumer creates the account through the existing Product API boundary; the deterministic action CAS commits the account reference and completes the plan/task in one transaction. The model only proposes 'enter simulated validation'; it never creates the account, chooses its identity, approves, mints an idempotency key or executes orders. An exact replay returns the same account/receipt with zero model calls; no order/position/fill is created.
non_claims: P4-B proves only the normal path; the async-handoff fault matrix, P4-C1/P4-C2 and P4-D are not run.
No production deployment, version write, tag or release.
No real-LLM research-quality semantic claim (keyless scripted provider).
No Phase 100 resume and no 0.10 start.
No second generic agent harness or session store.
